## Key points

- Reconciliation revamp is a Q3 anchor; build internally rather than buy a vendor.
- Marcus will coordinate Karim’s two-week platform support for ledger integration.
- Mobile receipt capture v1 will ship without bulk-select; bulk-select is a fast-follow roadmap item.
- OCR confidence indicator will be made more prominent in the mobile receipt-capture specs.
- Vendor payout target is 48-hour p95 from invoice approval, with a proposed 4-hour ACH batching window and a second west-coast approver.
- The vendor payout SLA plan is contingent on SRE confirming the increased monitoring load is manageable; otherwise, intermediate targets will be considered.
- Audit-log retention work is confirmed for Q4 with Legal.
- The internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern team.
- A rotating engineering on-call structure will be proposed to address bug-bash burnout.
- Q3 scope will be circulated for review before the Friday lock and presented at the Monday executive review.

## Action items

- Marcus: Confirm Karim’s availability with his manager, by this week.
- Dan: Update the mobile receipt-capture specs, including the prominent OCR indicator and no bulk-select in v1, by Wednesday.
- Marcus: Complete the ACH batching-window trade-off analysis and obtain SRE input, by next week.
- Jenna: Partner with Marcus on the ACH/SLA analysis, by next week.
- Marcus: Propose a rotating engineering on-call structure, by August 31.
- Priya: Circulate the Q3 scope draft for review, by Thursday morning.
- Sara: Present the finalized Q3 scope at the executive review, Monday.
